## About MJRCET
MJR College of Engineering and Technology, under the umbrella of MJR Eduacational Society is one of the well known technical institutions in Chittoor District, Andhra Pradesh (A.P). It is located in Diguvapokulavari Palli, Piler on the Chittoor-Kadapa Highway in a beautiful 10-acre campus. Beginning its quality inputs in 2009, MJR College of Engineering and Technology has become one of the best engineering colleges in Chittoor District, Andhra Pradesh for quality management within a short span of time.
